full_judgment: 14. Admittedly, the assessee-company borrowed the loan amount from 'Janata Bank' which is not run on Islamic Principles and the assessee-company failed to prove by showing any evidence that the loan amount borrowed for the purpose of it's business which are the preconditions for allowing deduction under Section 29 of the ITO, 1984. Though the respondent claimed that it lend the borrowed money to its sister concern but failed to produce any evidence in this regard. The burden of proof lies on the party which asserts the substantially affirmative of the issue and not upon the party who denies it.
